# Bineesh S

Developer portfolio of Bineesh S: Tech-Driven Innovator, Tech Entrepreneur, AI Expert, Python Developer, and Cybersecurity professional. Founder & CEO of Fusintech, Co-founder & CAIO of Corepro Techno LLP and Co-founder & CTO of Fitaval.

## About
* **Bio**: Founder & CEO of Fusintech, Co-founder & CAIO of Corepro Techno LLP and Co-founder & CTO of Fitaval. Aspiring Full-Stack Developer specializing in Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Full Stack, Cybersecurity). Proactive, self-taught, and passionate about creating modern, robust applications, designing intelligent platforms, and solving complex technical challenges.

## Featured Projects

### Nikah.com — Matrimonial Advertising & Profile Sharing Website (ID: 21)
* **Description**: A clean, trust-focused website for a matrimonial advertising and profile-sharing service in Kerala, with a transparent four-step process, clear policy pages, testimonials, an FAQ and WhatsApp-first contact.
* **Tech**: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, SEO, WhatsApp Integration
* **Live**: https://www.nikahcom.in/
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/happyweddingofficial/community-connect-hub
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=nikah-com

### Fitaval — Multi-Tenant Fitness Business Platform (ID: 19)
* **Description**: A complete fitness-business ecosystem: a member mobile app, a gym management CRM and a super-admin console, giving gym owners, staff, trainers and platform operators one connected system.
* **Tech**: Flutter, Dart, React, JavaScript, Mobile App, Web CRM, Multi-Tenant, Role-Based Access
* **Live**: https://www.fitaval.com/
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=fitaval

### Gate Hypermarket — Retail Website with Flyers, Stores & Careers (ID: 20)
* **Description**: A full retail website for Gate Hypermarket in Dubai and Ajman: weekly digital flyers, store locator, blog, careers portal with online applications, and an admin panel to manage all content and SEO without code.
* **Tech**: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, CMS Admin Panel, SEO, Responsive Design
* **Live**: https://www.gateuae.com/
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=gate-hypermarket

### CorePro Sales Hub — Sales CRM Platform (ID: 10)
* **Description**: A role-based sales CRM for CorePro Techno: lead management with CSV/Excel import, monthly target tracking for sales executives, and a live team dashboard for managers and admins.
* **Tech**: TanStack Start, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Firestore, Recharts, Zod
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=corepro-sales-hub

### UpliXo — Career Readiness & Consulting Platform (ID: 11)
* **Description**: A modern marketing and consulting website for UpliXo, a career-guidance partner for students, career returnees and working professionals, featuring an AI chat assistant and animated, high-polish UI.
* **Tech**: TanStack Start, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP, Motion, TypeScript, Vercel
* **Live**: https://www.uplixo.in/
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/Bineesh627/UpliXo
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=uplixo

### Nikah.Net — Muslim Matrimonial Advertising Platform (ID: 12)
* **Description**: A bilingual (English / Malayalam) matrimonial advertising platform for Kerala Muslim families, with searchable profiles, a 5-step ad wizard, shortlist, biodata view and privacy-first design.

### AgriCrop AI — Smart Crop Recommendation & Analytics (ID: 17)
* **Description**: A Django and scikit-learn web app that recommends the best crop from soil nutrients (N, P, K, pH) and climate (temperature, humidity, rainfall), with a crop library, prediction history and farmer/admin roles.
* **Tech**: Python, Django, Scikit-Learn, Random Forest, Pandas, NumPy, SQLite, JavaScript
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/Bineesh627/agricrop_ai
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=agricrop-ai

### INNOVERSSE — AI Video Creation Masterclass Website (ID: 18)

### Cervical AI — Federated Learning Cancer Screening (ID: 8)
* **Description**: A privacy-preserving multimodal AI system utilizing PyTorch models and the Flower federated learning framework for early cervical cancer detection.
* **Tech**: Python, Django, PyTorch, Federated Learning, Explainable AI
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/Bineesh627/cervical_ai
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=cervical-ai

### RAG Chatbot — AI College Assistant (ID: 1)
* **Description**: Developed a college chatbot leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in collaboration with the principal. The system employs intelligent agents to extract information from the college website and PDF documents, all managed through a dedicated admin panel for seamless operation.
* **Tech**: Python, Bootstrap, Django, Langchain, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Numpy
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/Bineesh627/college_chatbot
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=rag-chatbot

### TruthGuard — LSTM-Based Fake News Detector (ID: 7)
* **Description**: A Django-based web application that uses a TensorFlow/Keras LSTM neural network to detect fake news from text or URLs in real-time.
* **Tech**: Django, TensorFlow, Python, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS
* **GitHub**: https://github.com/Bineesh627/fakenewsdetector
* **Case Study**: https://bineeshs.vercel.app/project?slug=truthguard

### MobileInfoga — OSINT Phone Reconnaissance Toolkit (ID: 3)
* **Description**: MobileInfoGa is a powerful OSINT tool designed to gather comprehensive details about phone numbers. Utilizing various techniques and integrations, it can retrieve information such as country of origin, carrier details, and potential online associations.
